name: litellm-vscode-chat
displayName: LiteLLM Provider for GitHub Copilot Chat
description: An extension that integrates LiteLLM into GitHub Copilot Chat

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: LiteLLM API key. Leave empty for servers without authentication.

litellm-vscode-chat.defaultMaxOutputToke.description: Default maximum output tokens when not provided by model info

litellm-vscode-chat.defaultContextLength.description: Default context length when not provided by model info

litellm-vscode-chat.defaultMaxInputToken.description: Default maximum input tokens (if null, calculated as contextLength - maxOutputTokens)

litellm-vscode-chat.promptCaching.enable.description: Enable prompt caching for supported models (currently Anthropic Claude). Caches the system prompt to reduce costs and improve response times. Only affects models that advertise prompt caching support.

litellm-vscode-chat.modelParameters.description: Model-specific request parameters to customize API behavior. Supports max_tokens, temperature, top_p, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, stop, etc. Uses longest prefix matching (e.g., 'gpt-4' matches 'gpt-4-turbo:openai'). To scope parameters to a specific server, prefix with the server's base URL (e.g., 'http://localhost:4000/gpt-4') or, for servers configured before the provider-group migration, the server label (e.g., 'Production/gpt-4'). Server-scoped entries take priority over unscoped ones. Only parameters you set are sent; the extension never injects defaults.

litellm-vscode-chat.headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to include with all LiteLLM requests (model discovery and chat completions). Useful for API gateways that require headers like x-litellm-api-key. If values contain secrets, prefer User settings (not workspace settings) to avoid accidental commits.

litellm-vscode-chat.maskApiKeyInput.description: Mask the API key input field when configuring. Disable to see the key as you type.

litellm-vscode-chat.requestTimeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for chat completion requests. Default is 300000ms (5 minutes). Increase this value if you're experiencing timeout errors with long-running requests.

litellm-vscode-chat.discoveryTimeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for model discovery requests. Default is 30000ms (30 seconds).

scripts.test: bun run compile && bun run bundle:dev && vscode-test --label unit
scripts.test:coverage: bun run compile && bun run bundle:dev && vscode-test --label unit --coverage && bun scripts/check-coverage.ts
